cleaner.chip_outside_preview: Errors are beyond the 100 preview rows
cleaner.help_docs_desc: Inspect and fix common data issues before visualizing. Your original file remains untouched.
cleaner.help_docs_step1_text: Inspect and fix errors before creating charts. Your original file remains unchanged.
cleaner.help_docs_step2_text: Includes missing cells, type mismatches (text in numeric columns), bad characters, semantic errors (e.g. invalid phone/email), and duplicate rows.
cleaner.help_docs_step3_text: Click an issue chip to jump to that column; use 'Prev/Next error' or filters for error-only rows/columns. The preview shows the first 100 rows, and chips tell you how many errors lie beyond.
cleaner.help_docs_step4_text: Auto-Clean (removes duplicates, drops ≥ 90% empty columns, fills missing: numeric → median, categorical → 'Unknown'); Manual Clean (decide per issue); Skip (keep data as is). Auto-Clean applies across the full file, not just the first 100 rows.
cleaner.help_docs_step5_text: Green cells are modified cells — hover over them to inspect 'old → new'. Choose 'Clean more' or 'Use this version'.
cleaner.help_docs_step6_text: Click an error cell to apply suggestions, edit value, set empty, or ignore. Column header menus allow renaming, filling missing, or dropping columns file-wide. Click 'Save' to record edited cells, and 'Finalize' to confirm. Delete an action from the log to undo.
cleaner.help_docs_step7_text: Proceed to the Visualize step. File sessions last for 1 hour; simply re-upload if expired.

visualize.help_docs_step2_text: Browse Distribution, Correlation, and Over Time tabs. Click any cell on the correlation heatmap to view a detailed scatter plot.
visualize.help_docs_step3_text: Each card includes a column title, descriptive base row, automatic statistical insights, and an Enlarge button for full detail.
visualize.help_docs_step4_text: For multiple-choice questions, percentages are calculated per respondent, so total percentages may exceed 100%.
